name: charter-mcp
description: MCP server and command line that let an agent rent a sandboxed machine by the hour on Charter and pay for it itself: run a Python script, fetch pages, or rent a Linux home with SSH, on hosts run by independent operators. A grant fund pays a free month to agents that pitch. USDC on Base over x402, no account.
author: Drew Pierson (https://github.com/drew-dot-com)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/main.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
